retryWrapperCoverage.semantics: merge_group only (PRs never retry, deliberately). Does NOT retry when exit status >= 128 (signal/OOM). On double failure exits with the FIRST attempt's status and emits '::error title=Merge-queue retry failed::'. On retry success emits FLAKY_MARKER=LANGFUSE_CI_FLAKY_RETRY_SUCCEEDED and exits 0 explicitly. Header comment: wraps only suites with no retry of their own, because the second attempt runs against state the first left behind.
